definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture or shelving unit used to store and organize shoes, typically placed in the entryway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{靴棚|くつだな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I put a shoe rack in the entryway.

examples.japanese: {靴棚|くつだな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっぱいになってしまった。
examples.english: The shoe rack has become full.

examples.japanese: ⟦{組|く}み{立|た}て→組み立て：08645_kumitate⟧{式|しき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{靴棚|くつだな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an assembly-style shoe rack.

notes:
A shoe storage shelf, typically placed in or near the ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧ (entryway) of a Japanese home.

FORMS:
⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧ (shoes) + ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧→だな (shelf). The ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ undergoes rendaku (voicing) to become だな in this compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {靴棚|くつだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put shoes on the rack
- {靴棚|くつだな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧: to organize the shoe rack
- ⟦{組|く}み{立|た}て→組み立て：08645_kumitate⟧{式|しき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{靴棚|くつだな}: assembly-style shoe rack

ALTERNATIVE TERMS:
- ⟦{靴箱|くつばこ}→靴箱：09735_kutsubako⟧: shoe box/cabinet (more enclosed, with a door)
- ⟦{下駄箱|げたばこ}→下駄箱：06490_getabako⟧: shoe cabinet (traditional term from the geta era, still widely used)
- ⟦シューズ→シューズ：10962_shuuzu⟧⟦ラック→ラック：27072_rakku⟧: shoe rack (loanword)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Since shoes are always removed at the entrance of Japanese homes, having proper shoe storage at the ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧ is essential.
